about.title: Ridgecrest Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: Ridgecrest households rely on everyday products — from tools used out at China Lake to appliances and vehicle parts driven along S China Lake Boulevard and Rt 178 — and most of the time those products work as intended. But when a design flaw, manufacturing error, or missing warning label causes an injury, the person hurt is often left with medical bills and no clear path forward. California's strict liability framework means an injured Ridgecrest resident generally doesn't have to prove the manufacturer was negligent, only that the product was defective and that the defect caused harm. Retailers and distributors can share responsibility alongside manufacturers. Our team handles product liability claims and can explain your options under California law.

items.title: Strict Liability Can Simplify Your Case
items.desc: Because California often applies strict liability to defective products, you may not need to prove the manufacturer acted carelessly — only that the defect existed and caused your injury.

items.title: Multiple Parties May Be Responsible
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and retailers can all potentially be held liable, which may broaden the paths available for pursuing a recovery.

items.title: Guidance on Preserving Evidence
items.desc: Our team can advise you early on keeping the product itself intact, since it's often the central piece of evidence in a defect claim.

items.question: Do I need to prove the manufacturer was negligent?
items.answer: Not necessarily. California product liability claims often rely on strict liability, meaning you generally need to show the product was defective and that the defect caused your injury, rather than proving carelessness. We can review your situation and explain which theory fits your facts.

items.question: What should I do with the product that hurt me?
items.answer: Try to preserve it exactly as it was at the time of the incident, including any packaging, parts, or instructions. The product itself is often the most important piece of evidence in these claims, so avoid repairing, discarding, or altering it before our team has a chance to examine it.

items.question: Is there a cost to contact you?
items.answer: No. We offer free case reviews, and we handle product liability claims on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless you recover compensation.
